Trouble

### MITRE ATT&CK

### Security Standards

 Configure Operating System to prevent enumeration of administrator accounts during elevation (disable registry key HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\CredUI\EnumerateAdministrators).
 Implement Group Policy to disable enumeration of admin accounts on elevation.

title: AdFind Command Line Usage
id: 8b0cbd31-5fc9-44b1-afd2-b595fd3e100a
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of AdFind with common reconnaissance switches indicative of Active Directory enumeration.
author: Shakedown
date: '2026-10-27'
tags:
- attack.discovery
- attack.t1087.002
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  sel_img:
    Image|endswith: adfind.exe
  sel_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
    - -kdsrootkeys
    - -csvbreakcount
    - -onlygroup
    - -whoami
    - -decattid
    - -enccurrentutcgt
    - -encutcgt
    - -outputcurrentint8
    - -outputcurrentgt
    - -jwdsinit
    - -jwdsstd
    - -jwdsstdro
    - -parentrdn
    - -objrdn
    - -dechextosid
    - -encguidtoiid
    - -sdna
    - -nosacl
    - -showdel
    - stats
    - stats+
    - statsonly
    - stats+only
  condition: sel_img and sel_cmd
falsepositives:
- Legitimate administrative scripts that use AdFind for benign purposes.
level: high

data.rule_text:
title: AdFind Command Line Usage
id: 8b0cbd31-5fc9-44b1-afd2-b595fd3e100a
status: experimental
description: Detects execution of AdFind with common reconnaissance switches indicative of Active Directory enumeration.
author: Shakedown
date: '2026-10-27'
tags:
- attack.discovery
- attack.t1087.002
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  sel_img:
    Image|endswith: adfind.exe
  sel_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
    - -kdsrootkeys
    - -csvbreakcount
    - -onlygroup
    - -whoami
    - -decattid
    - -enccurrentutcgt
    - -encutcgt
    - -outputcurrentint8
    - -outputcurrentgt
    - -jwdsinit
    - -jwdsstd
    - -jwdsstdro
    - -parentrdn
    - -objrdn
    - -dechextosid
    - -encguidtoiid
    - -sdna
    - -nosacl
    - -showdel
    - stats
    - stats+
    - statsonly
    - stats+only
  condition: sel_img and sel_cmd
falsepositives:
- Legitimate administrative scripts that use AdFind for benign purposes.
level: high
